Authors: Naroa Lopez-Larrea, Haifa Rimani, Jorge L. Olmedo-Martínez, Iván Rivilla, Alister Urain, Elena Gabirondo, Alba Gonzalez, Md Shafi Alam, Ilaria Abdel Aziz, David Mecerreyes

Atmospheric water harvesting (AWH) is an emerging technology for collecting water from fog and humidity. We propose a novel thermoresponsive hydrogel polymer network coupled with organic transparent heater for AWH and voltage controlled release.

DOI: 10.1039/d6tc02580c

item.title: Layer-resolved vacancy engineering in few-layer Bi 2 O 2 Se: defect stability, electronic structure, vertical-field tunability, and polarization-resolved optical response
item.description:
Authors: Jin-Hong Lian, Chiu-Chu Hsu, Jyh-Pin Chou, Wen-Jay Lee, Chandrasekar Sivakumar, Wei-Hsiang Lin, Chao-Hsin Chien, Mon-Shu Ho

Few-layer Bi 2 O 2 Se is promising for electronic and optoelectronic applications, although its electronic and optical responses are strongly influenced by surface termination and native vacancies.

DOI: 10.1039/d6tc03044k

item.title: Iodine-rich inorganic ammonium salt-based interfacial modification enhances the photovoltaic performance of inorganic perovskite solar cells
item.description:
Authors: Jia Li, Lin Qi, Yuhao Li, Sanlong Wang, Zhongke Wang

Ammonium triiodide (AT) modulate the interfacial energy level to enhance photovoltaic performance. The inverted device achieves a power conversion efficiency of 20.23%.
